name: ADAMAS ZERO
source:
A parody game featuring Gun*am SEED DESTINY.

Ne*, defeated by Kira and saved by AA. At the same time, Asl*n gets injured and saved by AA. 
What destiny awaits the three?
This is a novel adventure!
